purpose: Predefined Phase A gates and selection rules, fixed BEFORE any Phase A inference. Phase A uses synthetic, template-generated consultations only (phase_a/synth_gen.py, seed fixed); no project transcript, label, validation, locked-test or Batch 002 file is used.

synthetic_set.note: disjoint from the 3 hand-written feasibility cases

settings_fixed.model: Qwen3-0.6B OpenVINO FP16 (EXP_002 IR), GPU, greedy, thinking off

prompt_candidates.P2: P1 plus a one-paragraph compact output skeleton with angle-bracket descriptions (no blank strings)

prompt_selection_rule: Run P1 and P2 unconstrained on R1 over the 10 cases. Choose the prompt with more valid-JSON outputs; tie -> higher mean expected-fact recall; tie -> P1 (shorter). The chosen prompt text is used for B1, B2 and B3 (same wording; only the layout sentence differs by rendering). No further prompt edits.

grammar_variants_in_order.G2: G1 + every list capped at 20 items
grammar_variants_in_order.G3: G2 + forced answer prefix '{"chief_complaint":"' supplied as the start of the assistant turn (grammar continues after it)

grammar_selection_rule: Evaluate G1, G2, G3 in this order with the chosen prompt on R1; B3 uses the FIRST variant that passes Gate C. If none passes, Gate C fails. No other variant may be added without approval.

criteria: valid JSON >= 7/10 on R1 with the chosen prompt
valid JSON >= 7/10 on R0 (original rendering) with the chosen prompt
gate_P_prompt_unconstrained.if_fails: B1 and B2 are not run; stop and report

criteria: empty collapse = 0 (empty collapse = chief_complaint shorter than 4 characters or consisting only of punctuation, or every list empty)
repetition loops = 0 (loop = any list with >= 3 items identical in their primary field, or >= 3 items whose primary field is none/null/n-a/empty-like)
chief_complaint contains at least one expected key word in >= 7/10 cases
expected medication names found (micro, across cases) >= 0.60
reported_by correct (== expected role) for >= 0.90 of matched expected items, and no reported_by outside the role vocabulary
no category collapse: for each of symptoms, negative_findings, medications, vital_signs, investigations, follow_up the expected-item recall across the 10 cases is > 0.20
gate_C_constrained.if_fails: B3 is not run; stop and report; no new variant without approval

phase_A_overall: B1/B2 proceed iff gate P passes. B3 proceeds iff gate P and gate C pass. If gate P fails nothing proceeds.
metrics_definition: expected facts are known by construction of the synthetic generator; matching = lower-case substring of the expected name in the item's primary field; the same code scores every variant. These are feasibility gates, not extraction-quality claims.
